notes: Pick by seed type; skip what you can infer or inspect, and mark those as [My inference].

questions.text: When does this get used?
How do you do it today, and which step is the most painful?
What happens if it never gets built?
What have you tried before, and why did you stop?
Just you, or other people too? How many?
How technical are the users?
Where will it run?
Who maintains it after v1?
What form should the deliverable take?
What should the user see first? Name one product with a similar feel.
What is the first action a user takes? And the second?
Where does the input come from?
Where should the output go?
If only one feature could survive, which one?
What is explicitly out of scope for v1?
What must stay compatible (file formats, old data, another tool)?
What must never be touched (files, accounts, production)?
What scale is enough (rows, users, file size)?
How will you test it? Walk through the clicks.
What makes you say "this version works"?
What makes you say "this version is good"?
What would make you abandon it?
When do you want the first version?
Any required stack, or should I choose?
Where does it run, and do you have admin rights there?
Any login, API key, or data that must stay on this machine?
Any budget for paid services?
